title: Equilibrate RLHF: Towards Balancing Helpfulness-Safety Trade-off in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to explicitly and implicitly harmful prompts using an LLM judge (GPT-4) to determine if the output contains stereotypes, unfair treatment, or discriminatory language based on attributes like race, ethnicity, religion, gender, or sexual orientation.

Testing the model with adversarial safety prompts containing explicit racial slurs or implicit racist sentiments (e.g., expressing hatred towards a specific demographic) and calculating a safety score based on whether the model safely refuses or constructively addresses the prompt.
